exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix dump-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: dump-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create --type workstream --summary 'Coordinate the release.' 'Release workstream'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-1.txt
exec card create --summary 'Build the release.' 'Build artifacts'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-2.txt
exec card create --summary 'Published release notes.' 'Published notes'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-3.txt
exec card create --summary 'Abandoned release task.' 'Abandoned task'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-4.txt
exec card create --summary 'Approve the release.' 'Release approval'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-5.txt
exec card issue edit dump-2 --parent dump-1 --add-depends-on dump-5
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-2.txt
exec card issue edit dump-3 --parent dump-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-3.txt
exec card issue edit dump-4 --parent dump-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-4.txt
exec card close dump-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-3.txt
exec card cancel dump-4
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/cancel-4.txt
exec card --actor operator log add dump-2 'Build log captured.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/log-2.txt
exec card state set dump-2 'Next: publish artifacts.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state-2.txt
exec card result set dump-5 'Approved.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/result-5.txt

# A whole-board dump publishes linked Markdown and reports every managed file.
exec card dump board-dump
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-all.txt
cmp board-dump/README.md $WORK/golden/board-README.md
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-1.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-1.md
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-2.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-2.md
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-3.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-3.md
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-4.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-4.md
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-5.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-5.md

# Identical reruns preserve every generated file, while quiet suppresses notice.
exec card --quiet dump board-dump
! stdout .
! stderr .
exec card dump board-dump
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-unchanged.txt

# A changed record rewrites generated output without changing stable paths.
exec card state set dump-2 'Next: verify artifacts.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/state-2.txt
exec card dump board-dump
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-changed.txt
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-2.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-2-updated.md

# Issue selection includes containment descendants, not dependencies. Overlapping
# roots normalize to the root that already covers the other selected issue.
exec card dump selected-dump --issue dump-2,dump-1 --issue dump-1
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-selected.txt
! exists selected-dump/README.md
cmp selected-dump/issues/dump-1.md $WORK/golden/selected-dump-1.md
cmp selected-dump/issues/dump-2.md $WORK/golden/selected-dump-2.md
cmp selected-dump/issues/dump-3.md $WORK/golden/selected-dump-3.md
cmp selected-dump/issues/dump-4.md $WORK/golden/selected-dump-4.md
! exists selected-dump/issues/dump-5.md

# --no-descendants selects only the normalized named issues.
exec card dump named-dump --issue dump-3,dump-1 --issue dump-1 --no-descendants
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-named.txt
! exists named-dump/README.md
cmp named-dump/issues/dump-1.md $WORK/golden/named-dump-1.md
cmp named-dump/issues/dump-3.md $WORK/golden/named-dump-3.md
! exists named-dump/issues/dump-2.md
! exists named-dump/issues/dump-4.md
! exists named-dump/issues/dump-5.md

# Issue-selected updates are additive: README and unselected issue pages remain.
cp board-dump/README.md board-readme.before
cp board-dump/issues/dump-5.md dump-5.before
exec card dump board-dump --issue dump-1
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-additive.txt
cmp board-dump/README.md board-readme.before
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-5.md dump-5.before

# A modified generated page blocks a kind rewrite without force.
exec card create --type workstream --summary 'Track a standalone rollout.' 'Standalone rollout'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-6.txt
exec card dump board-dump --issue dump-6
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-6-workstream.txt
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-6.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-6-workstream.md
exec sh -c 'printf "local edit\n" >> board-dump/issues/dump-6.md'
exec sh -c 'printf "unowned\n" > board-dump/local.md'
exec card issue edit dump-6 --type task
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-6.txt
! exec card --json dump board-dump --issue dump-6
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/modified-error.txt
cmp board-dump/local.md $WORK/golden/unowned.txt

# --force repairs the recognized generated counterpart and preserves unowned files.
exec card dump board-dump --issue dump-6 --force
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-6-force.txt
cmp board-dump/issues/dump-6.md $WORK/golden/board-dump-6-task.md
cmp board-dump/local.md $WORK/golden/unowned.txt

# Unknown selectors fail without publishing a destination.
! exec card dump unknown-dump --issue dump-missing
! stdout .
stderr 'issue not found'
! exists unknown-dump

# Help states the one-way presentation contract and no longer exposes --subtree.
exec card dump --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/help.txt
! stderr .
! exec card dump invalid-dump --no-descendants
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/invalid-error.txt
! exists invalid-dump

-- golden/help.txt --
Usage: card dump <directory> [flags]

Publish a human-readable Markdown dump.

Publish a deterministic Markdown view of a board or selected containment
subtrees.

Arguments:
  <directory>    Directory to create or update.

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.
      --store=PATH         Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides
                           automatic discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD        Coordination board ID or exact name
                           ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR        Identity that owns active claims and attributes
                           changes. Defaults to the current OS username
                           ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json               Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet              Suppress status notices while preserving requested
                           output and errors.
  -V, --version            Print version information and exit. This flag must
                           precede any command.

      --issue=ISSUE,...    Issue root to publish. Repeat for multiple roots.
      --no-descendants     Publish only named issues, without containment
                           descendants.
      --force              Replace recognized generated files modified after
                           publication.
-- golden/invalid-error.txt --
error: --no-descendants requires --issue
